text:
Most of this was already built by an earlier task, so my commit only adds the title lookup. That earlier commit, `6a86a5de4` (the `cloud-sessions-listed` task), already added `AISessionIndex.record_snap()`, a watch on `session.jsonl`, a start-up scan, a test, and the readme row.

- **My commit:** `e04f922fd` on worktree `qf-6` (branch `worktree/qf-6`), not merged. It makes `record_snap` read the title from `session.summary.json` first. Before, the cloud voice session showed its folder name. Now it shows "Task system and voice agent". I did not touch the readme, since its row already covers this.
- **Counts:** today's live `index.json` still has 58 snapshots and none for `cloud-voice-task-system-and-voice-agent-exploration`. The running dev server has not loaded the earlier commit yet. I did not run the writer, so the before and after counts are not measured. I called `record_snap` on the real folder instead, and it returns a full snapshot (`cloud-voice-agent` kind, 8 minutes of activity, $0). `AISessionIndex.test.mjs` passes.
- **Restart:** yes, the dev server needs a restart. On start-up it adds the missing snapshot to the day index without dropping any existing one, and it picks up later changes to the folder on its own.

I appended the landing line to the task's `session.jsonl`. I did not send the `card_reply`, since I only have your note to go on.

On the two readme questions:
1. **Module readme:** I didn't edit it this time. The "How data gets in" row in `sessions/readme.md` was added earlier in `6a86a5de4` and already covers record-only sessions. My commit only changes the title lookup.
2. **Parent readme:** no change needed, because that line doesn't mention the title.

Every `ask_mastermind` answer now also goes to the voice app's inbox, so an interrupted call can't lose it. The change is merged into `michael/dev` but isn't live until Servex restarts, which I did not do. `RemoteMCP.test.mjs` passes after the merge. I skipped the smoke test as the brief said, since this is server-side only.

In `Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.js`:
- **Inbox:** every answer goes to `updates` with `reply_to` set to its ticket, whether or not the call returned it.
- **Cancels:** a `notifications/cancelled` now stops the wait at once. The answer then arrives through `updates`.
- **Restart:** each delivered reply gets a `remote-replies/<qid>.delivered` marker. At boot, any reply without a marker goes to the inbox once. The first run only marks the files already there, and files over 24 hours old are skipped, so nothing old is replayed.
- **Instructions:** one sentence added telling the voice agent to skip an answer it already has.

The three new test cases cover the cancel, an in-time answer also reaching the inbox, and the boot sweep.

I added the caveat line to `doc/cloud-voice-agent.md` and updated `doc/remote-tools.md`. The landing line is in the task's `session.jsonl`.

The boot sweep delivers a rescued answer without a chat line in the agent's `task.jsonl`.
